planValue: At Uber, I built an internal AI gateway that routes requests across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Azure OpenAI, with retries, caching, and structured output handling. I also built evaluation pipelines so changes could be checked against curated examples rather than judged only by feel. That combination of production infrastructure and careful evaluation has shaped how I approach AI engineering.
